title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
snippet: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.

title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
snippet: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.
